step1_analysis.description: This circuit acts as a modulation injection network for a VCO. It generates a bias voltage at N0, which drives the gates of NMOS switches (XM3, XM4) connecting the modulation input to the VCO control line, and MOS capacitors (XM5, XM6) that provide filtering.

paper_reference.title: A 6.5-GHz Energy-Efficient BFSK Modulator for Wireless Sensor Applications

Power_DC.description: Static power consumption of the bias network

sky130_expected.calculation: V_N0 is determined by the voltage divider of XM1/8 and XM2/7. V_N0 ≈ 0.71V. Current = 0.5 * 270u * 20 * (0.71-0.42)^2 ≈ 227uA. Power = 1.8V * 227uA ≈ 408uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on sky130 parameters for the diode-connected bias branch.

V_N0.description: DC bias voltage generated at node N0

sky130_expected.calculation: Equating PMOS and NMOS currents: 50 * 20 * (1.8 - V_N0 - 0.42)^2 = 270 * 20 * (V_N0 - 0.42)^2. Solving yields V_N0 ≈ 0.71V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact Vth and mobility ratio of PMOS to NMOS in sky130.

R_mod.description: Small-signal resistance between VMOD and VCTRL

sky130_expected.calculation: With VCTRL=0.9V and V_N0=0.71V, Vgs = -0.19V. XM3/XM4 are in subthreshold, so resistance is very high (>1 MOhm). If biased in linear region, it would be ~2 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Highly dependent on the DC bias of VCTRL and VMOD. At 0.9V, the switches are OFF.

sky130_expected.calculation: XM5 and XM6 act as MOS capacitors. Total W*L = 2 * 5u * 0.5u = 5 um^2. With Cox ≈ 5 fF/um^2, C ≈ 25 fF plus overlap and parasitic capacitance from XM3/XM4.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on gate area of XM5 and XM6 and typical sky130 oxide capacitance.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC bias, static power, modulation resistance, and control capacitance.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for BFSK Modulator Loop Filter
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN1 N1 0 1.8
VVCTRL VCTRL 0 dc 0.9 ac 1
VVMOD VMOD 0 dc 0.9 ac 0

XM1 N0 N0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VCTRL N0 VMOD GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VMOD N0 VCTRL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VCTRL N0 VCTRL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VCTRL N0 VCTRL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 N0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

.control
op
let v_n0_dc = v(n0)
let pwr = -(i(vvdd) + i(vn1)) * 1.8
print v_n0_dc pwr

ac dec 10 1 1G
let g_ctrl = abs(real(i(vvctrl))) + 1e-20
let r_ctrl = 1/g_ctrl
let c_ctrl = abs(imag(i(vvctrl)))/(2*pi*frequency)

meas ac R_mod_val find r_ctrl at=10
meas ac C_ctrl_val find c_ctrl at=100MEG

quit
.endc
.end
